title: How Finishing the Boring Task First Builds a Godly Man Nobody Has to Chase
caption:
The boring work is the resume nobody reads and everybody trusts.

Ninety percent done still means someone else remembers the last ten percent for you. A godly man notices what he's avoiding, does it before he feels like it, and finishes it all the way, not because it's exciting but because it's what's actually due.

"Whatever you do, work heartily, as for the Lord and not for men." Colossians 3:23

Reliability is boring work, repeated. That's the whole reputation.
